decision_basis: Endogenous apelin/APJ identity, APLNR perturbation, and ERK/Akt metabolic or angiogenic function support qualified-high relay/function evidence.
Exact AVP/V1A pharmacology with Gq/PLC/Ca2+/PKC and receptor-dependent MEK-ERK mitogenic outputs supports qualified-high relay/function evidence.
AVP-induced ACTH function in primary corticotrophs and Avpr1b-null mice, with receptor-coupling assays, supports qualified-high AVPR1B relay/function evidence.
BMP2/RGMa-conditioned ActRIIA receptor-complex dependence with BMP reporter and ALP outputs supports qualified-high relay/function evidence, not a standalone binary edge.
